notes: The default and rollback state is monitor. No callable rejects traffic until a platform administrator deliberately starts a canary.
Canary enforcement is restricted to exact selected leagues and exact selected callables, so friend leagues remain in monitor mode.
Starting a canary requires the exact build readiness gate, a valid administrator App Check token, verified recent authentication, a reason, and an immutable audit entry.
Returning to monitor mode does not require a valid App Check token, preserving an emergency rollback path when App Check itself is the suspected problem.
This batch never enables Firestore App Check enforcement and never promotes automatically.
Every selected league must already be marked Internal Test in appData/leagueAutomationQueueConfig.
